notes: Main areas with branches, branch departments and branch stores (legacy blocks AR_MAINAREA, AR_SUBAREA, AR_CTGRY_SUBAREA, AR_SUBAREA_STORES); rules in APP_RULES3_AR.

AR_MAINAREA.ACCOUNT_NO.lov: select account_number || ' - ' || account_name d, account_number r from ac_master where account_status = 1 order by 2

AR_MAINAREA.DISC_ACCOUNT.lov: select account_number || ' - ' || account_name d, account_number r from ac_master where account_status = 1 order by 2

AR_MAINAREA.ENTRY_TYPE.lov: select entry_type || ' - ' || max(entry_desc) d, entry_type r from ac_trn_codes group by entry_type order by 2

AR_SUBAREA.ACCOUNT_NO.lov: select account_number || ' - ' || account_name d, account_number r from ac_master where account_status = 1 order by 2

AR_SUBAREA.DISC_ACCOUNT.lov: select account_number || ' - ' || account_name d, account_number r from ac_master where account_status = 1 order by 2

AR_SUBAREA.SALES_MNGR.lov: select code || ' - ' || name_a d, code r from salesman order by 2

AR_SUBAREA.BR_MNGR.lov: select code || ' - ' || name_a d, code r from salesman order by 2

AR_CTGRY_SUBAREA.ACCOUNT_NO.lov: select account_number || ' - ' || account_name d, account_number r from ac_master where account_status = 1 order by 2

AR_CTGRY_SUBAREA.CTGRY_MNGR.lov: select code || ' - ' || name_a d, code r from salesman order by 2
